Spurious Liquor Claims 11 Lives in Madhya Pradesh's Sagar District

At least eleven people died in Madhya Pradesh's Sagar district after allegedly consuming spurious liquor. Eighty-four others are reportedly under treatment. The incident is suspected to involve an illegal supply network originating from Lalitpur in Uttar Pradesh. Authorities are investigating the matter.
